dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Xiǎonán, nǐ yǒu shénme Zhōngwén kè?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 口语课、阅读课和作文课。
dialogue.reading: Kǒuyǔ kè, yuèdú kè hé zuòwén kè.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 口语课！作文有点儿难，我写字很慢。
dialogue.reading: Kǒuyǔ kè! Zuòwén yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ xiě zì hěn màn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 你要记住：每天写一点儿！
dialogue.reading: Nǐ yào jìzhù: měitiān xiě yīdiǎnr!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Hǎo, wǒ huì jìzhù de. Xièxie nǐ!
